title: Guided Zodiac Tour Under the Iconic Bridges
includes: Food and drinks - Bring your personal water bottle (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health

blurb:
Skip the crowded cruises and experience Québec City from the water on a small-group zodiac boat tour on the St. Lawrence River.

With Les Corsaires du Saint Laurent, you’ll feel the river’s power while your captain shares real navigation insights, local stories, and perspectives you won’t get on typical tours.

A unique mix of adventure, authenticity, and iconic views all in a more personal, immersive setting.

Limited spots per departure. Book now to experience Québec City from its most powerful perspective.
